question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Vanish into thin air
solution:
The correct answer is: **"Disappear completely" **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Idioms mean an expression that cannot be understood from the meanings of its separate words but can be learned as a whole.
 
• This sentence goes in the form of a declarative sentence as it is a simple statement that contains some information.
 
 
• **Example:** I love to dance.
 
 
 
• The idiom Vanished into thin air means suddenly, mysteriously, or completely disappear.
 
 
• Example: They went off from the party. I parked my bike and it vanished in the air.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 The other options mean as follows 

 
• **Dilute entirely **means to make the concentration of some liquid substance loses its effect or force.

 
 
• **Example: **Use the shampoo in dilute form.
 
 
 
• **Postpone finally **means delay or put off later.
 
 
• For example: postponing classes is so irritating.
 
 
 
• **Mixing permanently **means mixing with something without any significant change.
 
 
• **Example:** The advanced technology mixed permanently in this new generation.
 
 
 
• After knowing all the meanings of the words given in the option "Disappear completely" suits the idiom.
